metadata.title: Data-quality triage board
metadata.subtitle: Severity reflects business risk, not row count.

dataPoints.business_risk: Can't connect transactions to customer history; loyalty, churn, and CLV all blind to these.
dataPoints.action: Investigate root cause (guest checkout? POS bug?). Flag the rows; do not drop.

dataPoints.business_risk: Will break time-based joins and dashboards silently — rows fall out of every window.
dataPoints.action: Reject at ingestion. Add validation rule: month ∈ [01–12], day ∈ [01–31].

dataPoints.business_risk: Probably a return — meaningful business signal, NOT a bug. Auto-deleting hides churn behavior.
dataPoints.action: Add a return-flag column. Keep the row; let analyses filter when needed.

dataPoints.business_risk: One outlier can dominate a mean. A single $99,999 row inflates AOV across the entire week.
dataPoints.action: Reject or quarantine. If real (corporate order), tag and analyze separately.

dataPoints.business_risk: Groups by store_id will treat 'A' and 'a' as two stores; rankings split into halves.
dataPoints.action: Normalize at ingestion (uppercase, trim). Add a uniqueness check on the dimension table.

dataPoints.business_risk: Anti-join surfaces it — see Chapter 5. Often a sync gap with the loyalty system.
dataPoints.action: Daily anti-join report; investigate any sustained increase in unmatched rows.

dataPoints.business_risk: Double-counts revenue, conversions, or any aggregated metric.
dataPoints.action: Look for a natural-key uniqueness check (transaction_id should be unique). Investigate, do not auto-delete.

dataPoints.business_risk: If churned customers are dropped from the master file, every retention metric is overstated.
dataPoints.action: Keep a soft-delete flag, never hard-delete. Customer master is append-only.

dataPoints.business_risk: A churn model trained on a 'days_since_last_purchase' field computed today learns nothing about future churn — it learns the definition.
dataPoints.action: Snapshot features as of the decision date, not as of today (see Chapter 27).
